meta.name: Glitch, iris and gloss
meta.description: Three cheat-sheet moves from engine primitives: a title torn into rows by the glitch's tear, an iris that opens from the sun icon into the next scene, and a premium pill polished by the sheen's gloss profile with a glint at its corner. Asset-free.
meta.creativeDirection: Audience: motion designers comparing LeClap with a motion-design cheat sheet. Direction: one move per beat on the house palette (ink ground, lavender and rose). The title holds, then tears for a beat: rows of the word displaced left and right with the RGB split and colour slices on top, then it settles. The next beat shows a sun in the top-left corner; the following scene opens out of that sun in a circle on an in-out curve, the sun swelling to 1.3x over 6 frames as the circle leaves it and a rose rim tracing the circle's edge, so the sun becomes the opening (a shared-element move, not a hole punched in it). The close is a pill badge that a broad, bright gloss sweeps once, then a star glints on its corner: one 12–14 frame twinkle. Review: the tear lasts under a second and the word reads before and after it, the iris circle is centred on the sun and grows out of it, the gloss stays inside the pill and never greys it.

sections.name: glitch
sections.purpose: The title holds, tears into displaced rows for 0.9 s, then settles.

sections.name: day
sections.purpose: A sun sits in the top-left corner: it swells as the next scene opens out of it, the circle's rim in the sun's rose.

inputs.name: sun
inputs.css: .wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 190px; height: 190px } .sun { width: 150px; height: 150px; border-radius: 75px; background: #f96f99; box-shadow: 0 0 0 18px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) }

sections.name: premium
sections.purpose: A pill badge: a broad gloss sweeps it once, then a star glints on its corner.

inputs.name: pill
inputs.css: .pill { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 22px; width: 520px; height: 140px; border-radius: 70px; background: #9298fb } .star { width: 56px; height: 56px; background: #f96f99; clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 61% 35%, 98% 35%, 68% 57%, 79% 91%, 50% 70%, 21% 91%, 32% 57%, 2% 35%, 39% 35%) } strong { color: #141416; font: 700 62px Rubik; letter-spacing: 3px }
